thesis: The hosts of Acquired abandon their standard studio format to host a live celebration of technology and the San Francisco Bay Area featuring CEOs from Spotify, Jensen Huang, and Mark Zuckerberg. They explicitly state that this event is a departure from their usual practice of studying the past to instead focus on the present.
